item.title: LA County Report: ICE Raids Result in $3.7 Million in Business Losses

item.title: Carjacker Convicted of Killing Man, While Co-defendant’s Jury Hits Impasse
item.description: A man involved in carjacking and killing a 24-year-old Riverside resident was convicted of murder and other charges, while his alleged co-conspirator’s jury was unable to reach a unanimous verdict, resulting in a mistrial, court records confirmed Monday.
